caption: Part one: Increased comfort! The frst picture is before. It's really nice, looks cute, 1 really liked it but it was not comfortable at all! My husband and I couldn't sit comfortably. With two couch dogs too...It wasn't working. I looked EVERYWHERE and finally found a couch that would work! It is amazing! It does several things: regular couch, recline couch (clicks down about 7 inches), pulls out to use as foot rest, pulls out to lounge (while the back is still upright), and lays flat. And the best part is you can have no arms, 1 arm or 2 arms depending on the space. We had to go with 1 for now. We are going to take out the benches and table and get a regular table with bench seats that have storage. Then it's the lights and curtains! I can't wait! You all give me so much inspiration! https://walmrt.us/4zR3EAK عرض أقل
